exact_full_target: For every C>0 a nonconstant total coordinate-transitive Boolean f with f(0)=0 and bs(f,0)>C*s(f)^2; also fixed alpha>2 and such F_m with bs(F_m,0)>=s(F_m)^alpha for all m>=1 and bs tending to infinity.

groups.name: Finite first-difference exclusion
groups.contract: Actual finite-set tournament counting; actual recursively defined Option-valued first-difference labels on Word K h; head-constant inheritance and quotient indegree; card≤3^h and card<82 at h4. Base K is an additive group with decidable equality and an assumed decidable irreflexive total relation R.
groups.outside: Paley-square specialization, finite-field number theory, and identification of recursive words with the manuscript function vectors.

groups.name: Affine vector and row-position algebra
groups.contract: Actual pointwise affine maps over a field. Explicit first-difference hypotheses remain explicit. For H a subgroup of K units, maps on (ι→K)×H are injective, transitive, closed under composition, contain identity and have a displayed left inverse.
groups.outside: No formal linkage to edgeLabel on Word, no Paley orientation invariance proof, no nested Boolean automorphism group.

groups.name: Conditional scalar profiles and strict seed
groups.contract: Finite-depth real coupled sequences from explicit inequalities, initial upper bounds, L≥0,ε≥0 and ε*3^(d+1)≤2. Bounds include u_n≤envelope≤2L and v_n≤εL(3^n−1). Side normalizations expose scalar assumptions. Strict actual seed (44M^21)^2<M²k^20 follows from M>0 and3M²≤2k.
groups.outside: No derivation of the four Boolean ordinary/joint recurrences, normalized maxima from those Boolean profiles, prime/rounding choice, OR balancing, block packing/composition, exponential divergence or logarithmic alpha theorem.
